BrochureContent.Content:
Charming c.900sqft 3 Bedroom waterside residence with panoramic uninterrupted views from the Red Strand Beach out beyond The Galley Head towards the Atlantic Ocean.

Dirk Cove is a hidden gem, unknown to most and a secluded haven in the heart of West Cork located only 12 minutes drive from Clonakilty.

The property is just a 2 minute walk to Dirk slipway and overlooks this Horseshoe shaped bay towards Dunowen Head. Dirk features a number of seasonal moorings and is an ideal starting point for a day's fishing or sailing.

The sizable plot extends to c.1.2 Acres with a large gorse-filled hill behind the house ripe for further usage or cultivation. It extends to the shoreline however would require further works for ease of safe access.

Its c.900sqft layout is tailored to take full advantage of light and views with most rooms having direct coastal views.

One enters into an open-plan reception/sitting room/ kitchen area ideally suited to entertaining and modern living. In the heart of this room is a cast iron solid fuel stove allowing for all year usage and keeping heat burning during the magnificent winter storms. A set of sliding doors open out on to the terrace for long summer alfresco dining.

The bedrooms are double sized with 2 of them enjoying the views over the bay.

These are complimented by a shower room and hot press / airing cupboard.

Externally the property features a gravel driveway and ample outside parking and storage space.

A large natural stone finished patio area located on the Southern side of the house is a sun trap and perfect spot for BBQ's with its elevated position offering both bay views and privacy.

This truly is a hidden coastal gem in a most spectacular and exclusive setting

Location; Clonakilty 12km, Rosscarbery 8km, Cork City & International Airport 60km

Services; Mains Water, Private Drainage, Broadband, Electricity, Oil Heating
